_comment: The second famous place (2026-09-04, section 60I), and the darkest scene in the menu now that the car park has gone. A lantern-lit back street rather than a neon crossing, for the rule every famous place follows here: BASE_NEGATIVES forbid text and logos, and a neon crossing is nothing but lettering. The lanterns carry the city on their own, and a wet back street under power lines is exactly what a 2003 holiday tape of Tokyo looked like.
label: Tokyo, at night

prompt._comment: Two light sources that do not match -- warm paper lanterns and the cold white of a vending machine -- is the same trick the kitchen preset plays with a bulb and a window, and it is what makes an interior or a night street read as real rather than lit for a shoot. The wet asphalt is doing the work a second light would: every lantern appears twice.
prompt.scene: a narrow back street in Tokyo at night, red and white paper lanterns hung along the eaves of low wooden-fronted eateries, a tangle of power lines overhead, a lit drinks vending machine on the corner, wet asphalt holding every light, a bicycle with a front basket leaning on a pole
prompt.light: the lanterns are the main source, warm red and orange from just above head height, a cold white spill from the vending machine cutting across it, everything above the wires going to black
prompt.lens: wide and close in the narrow street, the far end lost behind the lanterns, every light drawing a hard point, a little barrel bend at the edges
prompt.framing: chest-up under the nearest lantern, the street narrowing away behind
prompt._moment: What is HAPPENING, not what is in frame. A brief with no action in it is a portrait brief, and the model answers it with a portrait -- squared to the camera, arms hanging, waiting. Somebody caught halfway through something ordinary is what a real snapshot looks like.
prompt.moment: just stepping out from under a shop's split curtain, one hand still holding it aside, half turned back to the camera
prompt.eraProps: a flip phone with a dangling charm, a lit drinks vending machine, a folded paper map, a clear plastic umbrella hooked on a bicycle handlebar

motionHint: the lanterns sway a little on their hooks, a scooter passes at the far end, and the wet asphalt holds and loses each light as it moves

lookOverride._comment: Paper lanterns are a warm source in a dark scene, so this takes the amber push the car park used to have and opens halation further still: every lantern and the vending machine's front are blown highlights on wet ground. The most grain in the menu, because the scene is dark without being flat.

ambience._comment: A city at night heard from a side street: the hum of the vending machine and distant traffic as one low bed, a slow shallow swell for the scooter the motionHint sends past, and a short echo because the street is narrow and the fronts are close. Quieter than the car park was -- a back street at night is quiet, and the point of the lanterns is that nothing much is happening under them.
